about: Every number on these slides, with its source. Live facts were read from public, read-only endpoints on October 30, 2026 at 04:52 UTC; nothing that changes state was called.

claims.number: Lease reaping runs shortly after each lease expires, and on a cron every six hours
claims.source: Tessera's Cloudflare configuration sets the cron 0 */6 * * *, whose handler runs the reaper, and the coordinator also wakes itself just after the earliest lease expiry. Its public health reported the last run at 00:00:41 UTC on October 30, 2026.

claims.number: The daily check runs every 24 hours from 13:00 UTC, or on demand, and reads four services
claims.source: The daily check's public status, read on October 30, 2026 at 04:52 UTC: a 24-hour interval starting 13:00 UTC, on-demand runs only with a Tessera admin key, four services per check (Eranos, Tessera, Herma and Home's agent endpoints) and server repair off.

claims.number: The first full check ran on October 29, 2026 at 19:31 UTC, started by hand
claims.source: The daily check's public status, read on October 30, 2026 at 04:52 UTC: the latest run completed, with a manual trigger, started at 19:31:25 UTC and headed "First daily check".

claims.number: Tessera's llms.txt named 26 of the 37 tools that its tools/list serves
claims.source: The check's open finding of kind llms_tool_mismatch, severity low, in its public status. At 04:52 UTC on October 30, 2026, Tessera's live llms.txt still named 26 tools and its agent card listed 37.

claims.number: A fix merged in Tessera on October 30, 2026, not yet deployed
claims.source: Tessera pull request 20, merged at 02:49 UTC, renders every tool list from the tools/list registry. Its commit says the daily check recorded the gap and that the hosted pages need a redeploy; the live llms.txt was unchanged at 04:52 UTC. Nothing shows that a worker claimed the repair verb.

claims.number: The daily check claims one scan a run and queues at most eight verbs
claims.source: The limits in the daily check's public status, read on October 30, 2026 at 04:52 UTC: one claim and eight verbs per cycle. Verbs beyond the cap are deferred to the next run, never dropped.

claims.number: Herma's merged code refuses an operator-paid turn without the caller's own grant
claims.source: Herma pull request 12, merged on October 29, 2026, with main CI passing: operator grants are empty by default, so no caller may use operator-funded inference, and Anthropic and OpenRouter stay paused. Herma's deployment was held in the October 29 status report, so the hosted behavior is not verified.
Public GET requests to Tessera's health, agent card and llms.txt and to the daily check's status, with no key; nothing that changes state was called.

claims.number: Last lease-reaper run: 00:00 UTC on October 30, 2026
claims.source: reaper_last_run in Tessera's public health was 00:00:41 UTC, matching the cron every six hours. The same read returned ok and db_ok true.

claims.number: The daily check's first full run was started by hand on October 29, 2026
claims.source: The daily check's public status: completed at 19:31 UTC with a manual trigger, server repair off and no model call.

claims.number: First scheduled run due October 30, 2026 at 13:00 UTC
claims.source: next_scheduled_at in the daily check's public status. Scheduled checks stop on November 4, 2026 at 17:00 UTC, when their keys expire, unless new keys are issued.

claims.number: Tessera serves list_feeds, poll_feed and publish_feed
claims.source: The tools listed in Tessera's public agent card. Reading or publishing a feed needs a key; the unauthenticated feed list returned 401.
